start.speaker: Marjorie
start.content: Have you seen my key dearie? I... I'm quite the klutz, so I must have dropped it somewhere...

give_key.speaker: Marjorie
give_key.content: Thank you dearie! You'd think I'd have learnt to keep better hold of it by now. Always getting lost adventurers trying to put this key in a door when it's clearly for a drawer. Silly boys, they should learn by now that you just bang on the door 10 times and you'll get through easy.

no_key.speaker: Marjorie
no_key.content: Oh, that's alright dearie. I'm sure it'll turn up somewhere. Just keep an eye on the ground for me, would you? Knowing me, I probably dropped it somewhere painfully obvious.

reminder.speaker: Marjorie
reminder.content: Oh, hello again dearie! And don't forget what I told you, if you come across one of those stubborn doors, just give it a good knock 10 times. Works every time!
